name: Modern SEO - M4L1 Facebook Ads Overview and Unlock
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-22

Part of: [Modern SEO - Module 4 Client Acquisition and Pricing](lib:brain-modern-seo-module-4-client-acquisition-and-pricing) | [Modern SEO Course](lib:brain-modern-seo-course) | [Learning Index](lib:brain-learning-index)

# Summary
Module 4 opens (3:47) by switching from ranking clients to getting clients. The instructor names four acquisition channels: Facebook Ads, local networking, content marketing and referrals. His paid channel is a call-based Facebook Ads funnel, which he claims landed 97 clients in six months at $20 to $30 per call. The full system sits in a locked classroom.

# Key concepts
- **What the classroom holds:** campaign setup, ad creative, targeting, offers, sales scripts, email follow-up sequence and the client contract.
- **Funnel goal:** "Get local business owners on the phone."
- **Why it is locked:** "I don't feel like people should be running ads to attract clients until they can confidently demonstrate the value they bring to the table."
- **Unlock assignment:** a complete Core 30 gap analysis of any local business website (you do not need to own it), using the Module 3 process. It must show missing GBP category and service pages, existing pages to optimize, and a build priority. The instructor unlocks by hand.
- **Ad notes:** at least $20 to $30 a day for meaningful data; no promises or guarantees of results; follow the platform's rules on claims; you still need to convert calls.
- **Trade-off:** the other channels have lower barriers but take longer.

# Checklist
- Gap analysis done with the Module 3 process.
- Ad budget of at least $20 to $30 a day.
- No guarantees in ad copy; platform claim rules checked.
- A plan to convert calls into clients.

# How this applies to TAG clients
- The unlock assignment is the same gap analysis Kim would run for [Pipeliners (Hub)](lib:brain-pipeliners-hub), [Alphalete Trenchless (Hub)](lib:brain-alphalete-trenchless-hub) or [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub). Check with Scott before posting any client analysis in the instructor's group, since it shares client details; a non-client business also qualifies.
- "No guarantees" matches Kim's rule against unbacked claims in any ad or landing page copy.
- Facebook Ads for TAG's own growth is Scott's call and costs money; noted, not recommended without approval.
- Ad accounts stay read-only for Claude, same as Google Ads: recommendations only.

# Caveats and open questions
- 97 clients and $20 to $30 per call are unverified claims; how "qualified" was measured is not explained.
- Referrals are named but never taught.
- Unclear whether the classroom is free after unlocking or part of the paid Pro group.
